description: Stamp text (or a PNG/JPG image) on every page or on a page range.

image.description: Optional image watermark; used instead of text when given.

image_width.description: Image width as a fraction of page width.

input.description: A file given as a local path or as base64.

base64.description: File contents as base64 (use for remote clients or small files).

name.description: File name, used for naming outputs when only base64 is given.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a file on this machine.

output_dir.description: Directory to write results into. Defaults to the input file's folder.

output_path.description: Write the (single) result to exactly this path.

pages.description: Page range such as "1-3, 5, 8-12" (1-based). Empty = all pages.

return_base64.description: Also return the result bytes inline as base64 (default: only when no file could be written).

name: watermark_pdf
title: Watermark PDF
